svg.title: DineFlow - Payment Confirmation and Late Outcomes

g.text: DineFlow - Payment Confirmation and Late Outcomes
Start: valid quoted pre-order; customer confirms payment.
P-PAY proposed; order/visit eligibility rechecked at initiation.
[Order/quote closed, already paid, or unresolved attempt exists]
no new attempt; current status / reconciliation needed
Register Payment INITIATED with stable attemptId.
verified success / rejection / non-final or untrusted
UNKNOWN; closing the app does not cancel payment
[Checkout expires or reservation is cancelled/expires while unresolved]
REVIEW_REQUIRED; no new attempt or fulfilment.
Payment = SUCCEEDED; retain financial truth once.
Failed delivery preserves PAID; recover separately.
No rebooking and no automatic restaurant handoff.
Refund / review policy and owner remain D-04.
Apply the same eligibility/outcome handling above.
Late success on closed order -> REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Replay unfinished effects, never duplicate or regress SUCCEEDED.
End: verified outcome or explicit UNKNOWN awaiting reconciliation.
Closing the app after initiation is not cancellation before payment.
No approved timeout, refund policy, or provider protocol is implied.
P-PAY / P-INTEGRATION proposed; FR-008-FR-009; NFR-008; AC-002, AC-005-AC-006.
Reservation release follows its finite interval, independently of payment reconciliation.
